items.text: Ostranauts while rough around the edges, currently has been super fun to play through so far! There were a few bugs, and not everything is implemented right but the game is still early access and released just today so you gotta give it slack. The learning curve is pretty high especially without many tutorials. But I was able to figure it out soon enough and by god did it feel satisfying to do so. Honestly I love the aspect of scrapping derelict ships for profit while not knowing why those ships were abandoned in the first place. Super excited to see what the game offers later down the line
items.text_zh: 《Ostranauts》虽然粗糙，但到目前为止玩起来超级有趣！有一些bug，也不是所有东西都正确实现了，但游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，而且今天才刚发布，所以你得宽容一点。学习曲线相当高，尤其是在没有多少教程的情况下。但我很快就弄明白了，天哪，弄明白之后真的很有满足感。老实说，我很喜欢拆解废弃飞船来牟利，同时却不知道那些飞船最初为什么被遗弃。超级期待游戏在后续能提供什么内容。

observations.description: 并非所有功能都已实现
observations.evidence_zh: 并非一切都实现得正确
